scope: 范围：固定机械臂，原生 REMANI 在线规划，MPPI 唯一底盘执行者；非 Gazebo / 实车。

plans.scope: online native ROS numerical SIL; fixed arm, synthetic perception and lagged differential plant; NOT Gazebo/real robot
plans.comparison: native serial baseline; additional projected qualification/soft cost; execution-only; handover-only; both objectives
plans.engineering_scope: additional projected qualification/soft cost only; retain native 3D, self-collision, wheel and long-horizon dynamic guards; not full dynamic feasibility equivalence and not an endpoint-stagnation fix
plans.randomization: same declared scene/controller seed; online feedback diverges; not identical-input paired solves
plans.objective_weights_status: pilot weights unless independently frozen in a subsequent validation batch

trials.displacement_note: measured 5 cm from first post-consumption pose; not proof of forward task progress
